LU-12668 tests: add EC recovery core tests

Add tests 51a-53e exercising core EC recovery paths:

- test_51a/b: EOF boundary recovery -- verify data
  reconstruction at and near file boundaries
- test_52a/b/c: degradation limits -- confirm correct
  behavior when multiple stripes are unavailable
- test_53a-e: read offset and cross-component recovery
  for sub-stripe, cross-stripe, and cross-component
  read patterns
